limitations: Ordinary app/installer are unsigned; Windows security policies may warn or block them.
VB-CABLE settings use the official separate control panel; no undocumented driver registry edits.

Removal needs administrator approval, the official Remove Driver action, and possibly reboot. Other software/users may need the cable; shared dependency retention is prompted. Silent uninstall retains drivers.
Cross-user dependency use cannot be inferred completely; last-app removal checks the current user and warns about other users/software.
A/B and C/D are not bundled.
Actual in-app Qt button interaction was not separately automated; the exact shipped settings helper and its real control panel were exercised.
